entities.summary: Brandon Davies is an American-born naturalized Ugandan professional basketball player for Alvark Tokyo of the Japanese B.League. He also represents the senior Ugandan national team. He was an all-conference college player at Brigham Young University. Davies is a two time All-EuroLeague selection.
